setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1_000_000
k = 10
# 10-dim synthetic data, k clusters
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (k, 10))
kids = rng.integers(0, k, n)
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[kids] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'f{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['cluster'] = kids.astype(str)

steps.name: wait for ready (1M anchor UMAP can be slow)
set color column to cluster
steps.eval: const col = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'cluster'); a.view.palette = 'default'; a.setColorColumn(col.index);
steps.until: a.colorColumn !== null && a.colorMeta !== null && a.colorsAll !== null

steps.name: export html — 1M points, no tooltip text
steps.eval: a.htmlExportOpen = true; a.exportHtml({ tooltipColumns: [], linkColumn: -1, maxChars: 0, embedImages: false, samplePct: 100 })
steps.report: { size: h.htmlExport.size, nPoints: h.htmlExport.nPoints, url: h.htmlExport.url, loadMs: window.__lastViewerLoadMs }
